title: loroglossum caprinum var. calcaratum
intro: Loroglossum caprinum var. calcaratum, commonly known as the Spanish Mountain Orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to the Pyrenees mountains in Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Loroglossum caprinum var. calcaratum include anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
